title: SurrealDB 3.0.4 before 4.0.0 does not apply operator-configured WebSocket frame, message, and buffer size limits to…
description: SurrealDB versions 3.0.4 up to but not including 4.0.0 have a vulnerability in the GraphQL WebSocket upgrade handler at GET /graphql. The operator-configured limits for WebSocket frame, message, and buffer sizes are not enforced, causing the system to fall back to permissive library defaults. This allows unauthenticated remote attackers to send large amounts of data (up to 64 MiB per connection) by specifying the target namespace and database in request headers, potentially exhausting server memory and degrading availability.
